name: prompt-engine
description: Turns rough prompts into detailed, LLM-ready prompts by asking multiple-choice questions with recommended answers.
long_description: Prompt Engine finds what a rough prompt leaves out (goal, audience, context, constraints, format, edge cases), asks you a few multiple-choice questions with a recommended answer for each, then has Claude write a detailed prompt that explains every addition. It includes checklists for coding agents, writing, research, and image and video tools. The server never calls a model, needs no API key, makes no network calls and doesn't log prompts.

tools.name: enhance_prompt
tools.description: Returns the Prompt Engine method brief for improving a prompt.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Returns the full checklist for a domain: coding, writing, research, image-video or general.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Asks your clarifying questions in a form, with the recommended answers preselected.

tools.name: check_prompt
tools.description: A heuristic structure-and-lint report on a draft prompt.
